question: Does a grounded, falsifiable experiment proposed by campus DeepSeek improve delivered and interruptible performance beyond the identical local evidence guard and executable method space?
comparison: A uses the current local anonymous planner and its ordinary two-fold local challenger. B runs the same challenger and checks unstable changes against a saved primary champion on an untouched internal confirmation set. C adds at most one optional, asynchronous proposal to B. Same search split, candidate grammar, control allocation, incumbent protection and declared metric. All final selections are refit on all available task training rows. Baseline here means the current chooser under this common experimental allocation, not a new measurement of the released courses' accuracy.
resources: 16 real classifier fits including trials and refits, 600 s per path. Reserve 5 of 16 opportunities for a tail experiment and delivery; core search sees an 11-fit ceiling inclusive of its estimated refit. All three arms can run one competitive additional method on two matched search folds. Reuse available measurements. The same runtime classifier and bounded parameter alternatives exist for all arms. The optional campus call may start alongside ordinary search after two distinct primary trials leave common errors. When ordinary work is finished, wait at most 12 s for the advice, bounded by remaining time. No late rerun or new call. Deadline for a paid response at most 90 s. Four paid scopes at most, each at most RMB 0.12, existing local outbox, stop dispatch on any new unresolved usage. Real capped costs use refreshed course input/output pricing.
safeguards: Preserve deployed checkpoint and complete the core route. Freeze the proposed experiment including cited observations, hypothesized mechanism, possible refutation, minimum recovered shared errors and primary difference against the declared reference before running it. Candidate must beat the core result on both matched training folds with mean gain >=0.003. For B and C, a proposed change from the verified primary champion uses one sealed confirmation when fewer than two matched folds, smallest leave-one-fold-out gain below 0.003, or one fold accounts for more than two thirds of positive gain. On that independent set the new method must gain at least 0.003 in the declared metric; otherwise refit the champion. This independent set is excluded from every search fit and every proposal and is opened at most once for selection. Track ineligible, redundant, declined, failed, stale and unused suggestions. A task identifier never enters the policy.
panel: p81 seeded multivariate numeric binary task with a gated mixture of linear and local effects, seed 261181, 800 examples, balanced accuracy
p82 fresh crossed nominal multiclass table with noise, seed 261182, 900 examples, macro F1
p83 newly generated off-centre rings, crosses and bars in noisy grayscale images, seed 261183, 600 examples, accuracy
p84 Cornell/Pang-Lee subjectivity v1.0, 960 stratified, deduplicated snippets sampled at seed 261184 from frozen archive 985e501fbe891f050e2134be6d4cdb79e955435e240ea8f238b3fdb92ed839aa, macro F1
data: Hold out 25 percent of each deduplicated development task, stratification seed 261126. Runtime gets only training labels and outer features for prediction. Within training, reserve a grouped split for final confirmation, using the same split in A/B/C. If nested folds are infeasible, log the fallback and keep the existing planner. No released tasks, formal tests or team-designated hidden tasks. The public text is new to this study; prior pretraining exposure is unknown.
outcomes: Before scoring any outer labels, freeze hashes of all arm outputs and independent replays. Record the real published model at four completed search trials and at 30 seconds of native training wall time (including any API wait); use final if delivered earlier. Compare C-B (model contribution), B-A (guard contribution), and C-A. Report equal-weight task mean in declared metric points, worst per-task change, corrected/spoiled rows, actual fits, latency, known/unknown token usage. Improvement signal requires higher mean final score for C versus both A and B, no task losing more than 1 percentage point versus either at final or fourth trial, at least one actually executed informative paid proposal and successful independent final replay for every task. Four tasks are exploratory. No retuning on this panel. Preserve failed/partial rows and exclude incomplete triples from superiority claims.
